cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. The landing screen shows Development and Filter connections, and Query history is absent. A click on Development shows host dev-db.internal.acme.io. Enter finishes on Query 1 with status Connected to Development after Loading schema has left the screen. Ctrl+Y opens Query history with scope Development and status any, and the list hints include Rerun. The markers, No matching queries, and all connections are absent. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; click Development; Enter; Ctrl+Y

cases.disposition_reason: On Development, the editor runs a comment line t04_history_entry and SELECT slug FROM organizations WHERE slug = 'tessellate' LIMIT 1. A bare SELECT of a quoted marker has no FROM, so parse_select records Expected FROM and failed-only would keep that row. This read finishes with the cell tessellate and status 1 row. The editor is then replaced with SELECT 't04_history_decoy' AS marker, which is not run. Ctrl+Y opens Query history and the new row is the entry statement. Search for t04_history_entry keeps that row. Search for t04_history_missing shows No matching queries and neither marker. Esc clears the search. c shows all connections, including the Production row 4 min ago · 38 ms, and c returns to Development, where that row is absent. s hides the successful entry. The Development checkout failure stays visible, and the Production ordres failure appears only in all-connections scope. s turns failed-only off. The detail editor shows the entry statement and not the decoy. y reports Copied query. r, before Enter, opens Query 2 and finishes on tessellate with 1 row. The decoy and the pending-orders statement are absent. That finished result is captured at 120×40 and at 80×24, with the narrow shot taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. Enter then opens the same SQL in Query 3 with No results yet and does not run it. Ctrl+Q asks to quit because 1 unsaved query will be lost; Right then Enter confirms and the process exits 0.
cases.action_sequence: Search, switch connection scope and all-scope, enable failed-only, open details, copy, and rerun the selected entry. Also search a missing phrase.
cases.expected_results: The rerun result is that entry's statement. Empty search shows no rows.
cases.forbidden_effects: Rerun executes the previously active editor text instead of the selected entry.
